name: options_market_read_partner_acceptance_v1
title: Options Market Read partner acceptance v1

founderPriorityOverride.source: Founder direction before the Tuesday Qatom integration meeting.
founderPriorityOverride.purpose: Turn the working BTC Options Market Read v1.3 primitive into an integration-ready partner contract without broadening into advice or execution.

productScope.summary: Freeze, prove, document, and observe the v1.3 partner contract across isolated staging and production.

acceptanceCriteria: Keep the existing GET /v1/options-market-read v1.3 fields backward compatible; any additive change is documented and covered by contract tests.
Provide a repeatable conformance witness for default, exact-expiry, nearest-expiry, stale-data, unsupported-asset, past-date, and no-close-expiry behavior on staging and production.
Keep the partner handoff, OpenAPI document, machine help, and copy-paste examples consistent with the deployed contract and rendering hierarchy.
Record explicit founder and partner decisions for authentication, rate limits, CORS, alert destination, and non-PII usage telemetry; do not invent defaults for undecided controls.
Prove production promotion and rollback while preserving the isolated staging process/cache and the existing Options Market Read uptime agreement check.
Keep exposure selection, opportunity ranking, trade recommendations, execution, payment handling, historical volatility labels, and new assets out of this chapter.

forbiddenPaths: exposure, strategy, recommendation, execution, or payment APIs
changes that silently break schema_version 1.3 or ruleset_version options-market-read.v1.3
